function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build a CTE to get consecutive lap positions for each driver in each race
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, 
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE CAST(lap_type AS VARCHAR) = 'Race'
),
-- Add pit stop info
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
-- Add retirement info  
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, CAST(lap AS BIGINT) AS retirement_lap
    FROM retirements
),
-- Now identify which lap transitions to exclude
transitions AS (
    SELECT rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.position, rl.prev_position,
           rl.prev_position - rl.position AS position_change
           -- positive = overtook, negative = was overtaken
    FROM race_laps rl
    WHERE rl.lap > 1  -- exclude first lap (start movements)
      AND rl.prev_position IS NOT NULL  -- need previous position
      AND rl.prev_position != rl.position  -- only count actual changes
      AND rl.lap NOT IN (SELECT pit_lap FROM pit_stop_laps WHERE pit_stop_laps.race_id = rl.race_id AND pit_stop_laps.driver_id = rl.driver_id)
      AND rl.lap NOT IN (SELECT retirement_lap FROM retirement_laps WHERE retirement_laps.race_id = rl.race_id AND retirement_laps.driver_id = rl.driver_id)
)
SELECT driver_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN position_change > 0 THEN position_change ELSE 0 END) AS total_overtakes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN position_change < 0 THEN ABS(position_change) ELSE 0 END) AS total_overtaken
FROM transitions

-- Build a CTE to get consecutive lap positions for each driver in each race
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, 
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE CAST(lap_type AS VARCHAR) = 'Race'
),
-- Add pit stop info
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
-- Add retirement info  
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, CAST(lap AS BIGINT) AS retirement_lap
    FROM retirements
),
-- Now identify which lap transitions to exclude
transitions AS (
    SELECT rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.position, rl.prev_position,
           rl.prev_position - rl.position AS position_change
           -- positive = overtook, negative = was overtaken
    FROM race_laps rl
    WHERE rl.lap > 1  -- exclude first lap (start movements)
      AND rl.prev_position IS NOT NULL  -- need previous position
      AND rl.prev_position != rl.position  -- only count actual changes
      AND rl.lap NOT IN (SELECT pit_lap FROM pit_stop_laps WHERE pit_stop_laps.race_id = rl.race_id AND pit_stop_laps.driver_id = rl.driver_id)
      AND rl.lap NOT IN (SELECT retirement_lap FROM retirement_laps WHERE retirement_laps.race_id = rl.race_id AND retirement_laps.driver_id = rl.driver_id)
)
SELECT driver_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN position_change > 0 THEN position_change ELSE 0 END) AS total_overtakes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN position_change < 0 THEN ABS(position_change) ELSE 0 END) AS total_overtaken
FROM transitions
GROUP BY driver_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN position_change < 0 THEN ABS(position_change) ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN position_change > 0 THEN position_change ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY total_overtaken - total_overtakes DESC
LIMIT 20
